verdict.rationale: Okta's SSO docs establish the sign-in-once core: users authenticate once with the IdP and reach all connected apps. A hands-on community user notes the UI is acceptable and the Chrome plugin is 'OKish', which corroborates a browser extension. However, no first-party evidence describes the launcher dashboard or a catalog of assigned apps. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the end-user app dashboard/launcher, documentation of the browser extension, evidence that the portal shows exactly the apps assigned to the employee.
